correct_completion: she finished the report before midnight.
full_sentence: Although she was very tired, she finished the report before midnight.
acceptable_variants: she still finished the report before midnight.
she managed to finish the report anyway.

options.text: so she went to bed early.
options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, not a contrast. 'Although' needs a clause that goes against the expectation set by the first part.

options.text: she had to skip lunch again.
options.why_wrong: This gives another cause of tiredness, so it repeats the first clause instead of contrasting with it.

options.text: she finished the report before midnight.
she always drinks a lot of coffee.
options.why_wrong: This states a habit, not an action that contrasts with being tired, so 'although' has no clear opposition.

explanation: After 'although', the second clause must contrast with the first. Learners may choose a result or cause clause here, but the concessive meaning requires an action that is unexpected given the first part.
translation: Хоча вона була дуже втомлена, вона закінчила звіт до півночі.
